summary: Short, steep kerb at a junction corner with homes about 12 m away.

best_section.where: Almeida Street, east side, at the junction corner under trees

drivers.seclusion: Dense tree cover beside the kerb, but houses 12-13 m away and 8 homes within 30 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb sits at a road junction with trees and a bank beside it; little clear level ground to pull off.
drivers.convention: No cars seen parked along this stretch.

sun_shade: Heavily shaded by tree canopy, mainly from the east and north.
